{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
sales = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Step 1: Confirm the presence of QA orders in the full dataset
qa_orders_full = sales[sales['revenue'] == '999999.99']
print(f'QA orders in full dataset: {len(qa_orders_full)}')
print('\nStatus of QA orders in full dataset:')
print(qa_orders_full['status'].value_counts())

# Step 2: Filter completed orders
completed = sales[sales['status'] == 'completed']
print(f'Number of completed orders: {len(completed)}')

# Step 3: Clean revenue
completed['revenue_clean'] = completed['revenue'].str.replace(',', '', regex=False).astype(float)

# Step 4: Identify QA orders in completed group
qa_in_completed = completed[completed['revenue_clean'] == 999999.99]
print(f'QA orders in completed group: {len(qa_in_completed)}')

# Step 5: Remove QA orders from completed
cleaned = completed[~(completed['revenue_clean'] == 999999.99)]
print(f'Completed orders after removing QA: {len(cleaned)}')

# Step 6: Compute mean
mean_revenue = cleaned['revenue_clean'].mean()
print(f'Mean revenue: {mean_revenue:.2f}')

# Final check: no negative revenue
negative_revenue = cleaned[cleaned['revenue_clean'] < 0]
print(f'Negative revenue in cleaned data: {len(negative_revenue)}')

# Return final value
mean_revenue"}
